items.title: Muggsy Spanier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: He used to use a derby hat in front of his horn all the time. But he had a strong lip and he could play good, very good.

ctx.x: Well, it was a different style. He used to use a derby hat in front of his horn all the time. But he had a strong lip and he could play good, very good.
Was his range bigger or higher and all? No. In St. Oliver or somebody? No. Didn't go up higher, especially like Louie tried to get later or anything like that?
